scope.summary: BkFoundation integration test per Section 13.16 (BK-16.7 validation binding): one end-to-end kernel test that creates a body, sets multiple channel values through the API layer, saves a recipe, then replays the body from the EventLedger and proves the replayed BodySpec is identical to the stored authority row — closing the foundation group with a no-context-provable loop over MT-478..490.
acceptance_criteria: Integration test runs against the real Postgres test harness: POST body -> PUT 3+ channel values (mix of skeletal and tissue kinds) -> POST recipe save -> replay_body -> assert replayed BodySpec == fetched bodykit_bodies row.
The test asserts the full ledger event sequence (TailorBodyCreated, N x TailorBodyChannelChanged, TailorBodyRecipeSaved) in order with event_family 'tailor.body'.
Every authority row written carries a valid event_ledger_event_id resolving to a real ledger row.
Test is deterministic and self-contained: seeds its own base mesh fixture and channel registry entries; no reliance on prior test state.
scope.risk_if_missed: Without a group-closing integration proof, the foundation MTs can each pass in isolation while the composed create->edit->save->replay loop is broken, and 160+ downstream BodyKit MTs would build on an unproven substrate.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
